messages:
nina: hi folks, new hire here — trying to run the `frontend` Buildkite pipeline as part of my first-week checklist. checkout step returns 403 "The requested URL returned error: 403". i accepted the org invite yesterday. any quick checks?

carlos: welcome nina! usual suspects: missing SSH key, GH App install not granted for that repo, or SSO not fully linked. can you paste the checkout log?

nina: clipped log: ```fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood/frontend.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
remote: Repository not found.
```

tracy: also check if the pipeline is running on a private agent vs shared runner — our shared GH App covers org repos but private agents might need a deploy key. do you see `git@github.com` or `https://` in the remote?

nina: my local remote is SSH (`git@github.com:nina/frontend.git`). buildkite log shows https though. i haven't added an SSH key to my GH account yet.

carlos: add SSH key first: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "you@company.com"` then paste the pubkey into github.com/settings/keys. also confirm SSO link if your account uses SAML.

infra-bot: infra:created ticket #2472 "Add nina to ci-runners and verify GH App install on frontend" (assignee: carlos)

tracy: i'll invite you to `ci-runners`. if pipeline still tries HTTPS, we have a pipeline plugin that rewrites remotes for PR builds — i'll flip it to prefer SSH for private repos.

nina: accepted the team invite and added SSH key. re-triggered the pipeline UI.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite: pipeline `frontend/push` #9 failed on job `checkout` 1exit code 128 \u2014 fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': No such device or address

carlos: hm it still attempted HTTPS. tracy pushed a fix to the pipeline hook to prefer SSH; give it a minute and re-run.

tracy: pushed hook fix and kicked a manual rebuild. also confirmed GH App install was pending org consent; infra approved it just now.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite: pipeline `frontend/push` #10 succeeded on job `checkout` 1duration 34s

nina: awesome, thanks both. note for onboarding: add SSH key, accept ci-runners invite, and check for GH App consent. i'll add a short note to the new-hire doc.

carlos: welcome again! tag us in #eng-infra if anything else blocks.
